name: ExpressWay — AI Email Intelligence (IMAP single inbox)

parameters.content:
## Single IMAP inbox variant

Use this if you have **one shared mailbox** or want to test before scaling to 4 accounts.

1. Connect **IMAP credentials** on the trigger node
2. Set `sourceAccount` in the Set node to your inbox address
3. Set in `.env.local` (restart n8n): `EXPRESSWAY_APP_URL`, `EMAIL_INGEST_SECRET`, and **one AI key**:
   - `GROQ_API_KEY` — free at console.groq.com (recommended)
   - or `GEMINI_API_KEY` — free at aistudio.google.com
4. **Publish** workflow (n8n 2.x)

Duplicate this workflow for each additional inbox.
